body.heading: Where in the world is Sierra Leone?
paragraphs: Sierra Leone is a country in Western Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Sierra Leone is Freetown.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Sierra Leone speak English and Krio. Most people chat in Krio, a language that grew out of English; English is the official language of school and government.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Sierra Leone is the Sierra Leonean leone.

body.heading: How big is Sierra Leone?
paragraphs: Sierra Leone covers about 72,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Guinea-Bissau.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: In the forest above Freetown, Tacugama rescues orphaned chimpanzees. Families can tour the sanctuary, meet the chimps' stories and walk jungle trails.
A boat ride from the mainland, the Banana Islands offer quiet beaches, snorkelling and old village paths — a peaceful family day trip.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Sierra Leone on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
